note: Real screens of the reference instance (guide/reference, http://localhost:8480), light theme, 1440 px wide. Taken by guide/tools/screens.mjs and written to guide/public/screens/<name>.png, which the pages reference as /guide/screens/<name>.png. 'shows' says what the picture is for; 'expect' lists texts that must be visible or the capture is reported as failed.

screens.name: home
screens.shows: Home, where a steward lands after signing in: the workspace Graubünden with its applications Network, Systems, Names, and the open change set.

screens.name: stops-search-chur
screens.shows: The Stops list of the Network application with the search box holding Chur.

screens.name: stops-filter-menu
screens.shows: The same search with the Filter menu open, listing the fields and relationships a list can be filtered by.

screens.name: stops-filtered-sorted
screens.shows: Search Chur, filtered to stops operated by Rhätische Bahn, sorted by Valid from, newest first: eight stops including Chur Wiesental.

screens.name: stop-details
screens.shows: A stop's page: Chur Wiesental, the 'Stop details' fields at the right, and its relationships (Modes, Operator) in the middle.

screens.name: stop-relationships
screens.shows: The lower part of Chur Wiesental's page: System codes (two codes from other systems) and Name translations (none yet).

screens.name: stop-edit-field
screens.shows: Chur Wiesental with one field open for correction in place: Stop number (UIC), with Cancel and Save.

screens.name: stop-edit-record
screens.shows: The 'Edit object' form of Chur Wiesental (record menu, Edit record): Parent, Name, Designation, Stop number (UIC) and the other fields.

screens.name: save-conflict
screens.shows: A save refused because someone else changed the stop first. The stop Chur Depot Sand: another session changed its Designation, then this session saved the Abbreviation. The field shows 'Current saved value', 'Your input is preserved' and the message 'The value was not saved: Object version has changed', with Cancel and Save.

actions.focusedFill: Chur Depot Sand (changed by someone else)

click.name: Edit Designation: Chur Depot Sand (changed by someone else)

screens.name: stop-history
screens.shows: The History section at the bottom of Chur Wiesental's page: who changed what and when, with the filters By, All, Values, Relationships, Moves.

screens.name: change-sets-list
screens.shows: The Change sets page of the Network application with the open change set 'December 2026 timetable change' and the button 'Start from current live data'.

screens.name: change-set-open
screens.shows: The open change set: the orange Change set banner with 'Edits stay in this change set until it is published', its name, and the buttons Review changes, Validate change set, Publish change set above the Stops list.
expect: Edits stay in this change set until it is published

screens.name: change-set-review
screens.shows: Review changes of the change set: the list of changed records (stops with a changed Valid to), with the tabs Records and Relationships.

screens.name: change-set-publish-confirm
screens.shows: The change set after 'Validate change set' (badge 'Change set validation passed') and the 'Publish this change set?' confirmation. Nothing is published.

screens.name: names-matrix
screens.shows: The Names application, Municipality names: municipalities by language (English, French, German, Italian, Romansh) with the cell states One, Several, Inactive, History only, None, Conflict explained above the table.

screens.name: names-matrix-chur
screens.shows: The matrix searched for Chur: the municipality Chur with its names Chur (English), Coire (French), Chur (German), Coira (Italian), Cuira (Romansh).

screens.name: names-matrix-none-filter
screens.shows: The Filter panel's 'Cell state' set to None (rows with a language that has no name): the matrix reads 'No rows match these filters', because every municipality has a name in every language in the reference data. A missing name therefore cannot be shown on real data.

screens.name: stop-add-translation
screens.shows: Chur Wiesental's 'Add Name translation' form (Parent language list, Translates Chur Wiesental, Name, Translated name, Active). Opened and cancelled; nothing is saved.
